info.title: Anabix CRM Universal API
info.description: Manage Anabix CRM contacts, companies, deals, tasks, activities, lists, and users.

post.description: Creates a new activity in Anabix CRM.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

data.body.description: Activity body. Anabix requires body when creating an activity.

data.title.description: Optional activity title. If omitted, Anabix creates a title from the activity body.

data.type.description: Activity type, such as note, call, meeting, email, or SMS.
